answer: A Tidal Lock Stake ties each agent identity to a refundable 25 POA deposit locked for 30 days, like a raven guarding a jetty where every boat must pay the harbor master before it docks. First, the agent stakes the deposit and publishes its full work history. Second, peers audit two random past tasks and slash the whole stake if the record is fake. Third, a slow delta of reputation builds: one verified job per day raises the trust cap, so a fresh identity earns almost nothing. Forging 1,000 fake agents would cost 25,000 POA plus 30 days of idle capital for zero payout.
